cards.name: Amulet of Quoz
cards.note: ante

cards.name: Barbarian Guides
cards.note: missing snow landwalk of a chosen land type

cards.name: Battle Cry
cards.note: missing delayed trigger pumping each creature that blocks this turn

cards.name: Brand of Ill Omen
cards.note: missing static cast restriction on enchanted creature's controller

cards.name: Call to Arms
cards.note: white creatures get +1/+1 unconditionally, and it is never sacrificed: no condition reads the most common color among the chosen player's nontoken permanents

cards.name: Chaos Lord
cards.note: no upkeep control change (no condition reads the parity of the permanent count) and no attacking as though it had haste (a static reading Filter::EnteredThisTurn needs the engine's turn-boundary door first)

cards.name: Chaos Moon
cards.note: every upkeep red creatures get +1/+1 until end of turn whatever the number of permanents (no condition reads a count's parity), never -1/-1, and neither Mountain mana rider is played

cards.name: Chromatic Armor
cards.note: activated {X} sleight-counter color re-choice not supported

cards.name: Demonic Consultation
cards.note: reveals only the top card: into your hand if it has the chosen name, into your graveyard otherwise; the top six are not exiled and there is no reveal-until

cards.name: Diabolic Vision
cards.note: putting the remaining four cards on top of your library in any order not supported; puts rest on bottom

cards.name: Dreams of the Dead
cards.note: granted cumulative upkeep {2} and leave-battlefield exile replacement on the returned creature not supported

cards.name: Drought
cards.note: per-black-mana-symbol Sacrifice a Swamp cost increase on spells and abilities not supported

cards.name: Elkin Bottle
cards.note: play window expires at the start of your next turn instead of the beginning of your next upkeep

cards.name: Enduring Renewal
cards.note: revealed-hand static ability and draw-replacement top-card reveal/mill not supported

cards.name: Errantry
cards.note: can-only-attack-alone restriction not supported

cards.name: Flooded Woodlands
cards.note: the attacking player does not choose which land is sacrificed for each green attacker: the engine takes the first lands it finds

cards.name: Forgotten Lore
cards.note: the opponent's choice is missing: you target the card yourself (stronger than printed), and the {G} repeat is never offered

cards.name: Freyalise's Winds
cards.note: untap-step replacement removing wind counters instead of untapping not supported

cards.name: Fylgja
cards.note: the healing-counter shield targets the enchanted creature, which the card does not: no untargeted damage shield names an Aura's host

cards.name: Game of Chaos
cards.note: repeatable doubling-stakes coin flip loop not supported

cards.name: Gaze of Pain
cards.note: granted unblocked-attacker trigger locked to creatures controlled on resolution

cards.name: General Jarkeld
cards.note: the reblock is not played: the ability taps and targets two blocked attackers, and no blocker moves

cards.name: Ghostly Flame
cards.note: treating colored permanents and spells as colorless damage sources not supported

cards.name: Hipparion
cards.note: conditional blocking mana tax not supported

cards.name: Ice Cauldron
cards.note: the exile with a cast permission and the note of the mana spent are not played, and the second ability (remove a charge counter: add the noted mana) is absent

cards.name: Icy Prison
cards.note: upkeep mana payment offered to controller rather than any player

cards.name: Illusionary Presence
cards.note: the upkeep trigger offers only the five basic land types rather than any land type (CR 205.3i)

cards.name: Infernal Darkness
cards.note: cumulative upkeep asks for the {B} per age counter and then the 1 life per age counter as two payments in a row, so mana is spent even when the life is refused, and Braidwood Cup, Drought and Adarkar Unicorn do not see it as a cumulative upkeep

cards.name: Kjeldoran Guard
cards.note: body only; defending-player selection at activation is unavailable, so the optional pump and its linked sacrifice obligation are omitted together

cards.name: Krovikan Sorcerer
cards.note: the second ability ({T}, Discard a black card: Draw two cards, then discard one of them) is missing: no effect restricts the discard to the cards drawn this way

cards.name: Krovikan Vampire
cards.note: missing end-step trigger returning creatures dealt damage by this creature this turn that died and sacrificing them when you lose control of this creature; plays as a 3/3 Vampire with no abilities

cards.name: Leshrac's Sigil
cards.note: triggered ability when an opponent casts a green spell to pay {B}{B}, look at their hand, and choose a card for them to discard is not supported; only the {B}{B} ability returning this enchantment to its owner's hand is implemented

cards.name: Mind Warp
cards.note: choosing X cards from target player's looked-at hand for them to discard is not supported; looks at target player's hand without discarding

cards.name: Orcish Farmer
cards.note: body only; the optional land-type change is omitted because the affected-controller untap duration expires after untapping rather than before that step's untap determination

cards.name: Orcish Librarian
cards.note: no effect exiles four cards at random from the top eight cards of your library and reorders the rest on top; plays as a vanilla 1/1

cards.name: Sacred Boon
cards.note: prevents the next 3 damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn; putting +0/+1 counters on that creature at the next end step for each 1 damage prevented this way is not supported

cards.name: Seraph
cards.note: has flying; the delayed end-step reanimation trigger when a creature dealt damage by Seraph this turn dies and the sacrifice-when-you-lose-control trigger are not supported

cards.name: Urza's Bauble
cards.note: looking privately at a random card in target player's hand is not supported; reveals a random card from target player's hand to all players instead, then draws a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep

cards.name: Wiitigo
cards.note: checking whether this creature blocked or was blocked since your last upkeep is not supported; enters with six +1/+1 counters and always removes a +1/+1 counter at the beginning of your upkeep

cards.name: Withering Wisps
cards.note: the per-turn activation cap is the number of snow Swamps you control, but ActivationLimit::PerTurn is a fixed number: the card allows one activation per turn while you control a snow Swamp, which is fewer than printed with two or more
